narr: During the late afternoon and evening hours on June 3rd, a cluster of thunderstorms produced heavy rainfall leading to mud slides and flooding on local roads and highways in Grant County.
ev: The public reported a mud slide on Dog Tail Rd. north of Highway 133.
The public reported culverts overflowing across Highway 81.
Street flooding was reported on Grandview Lane.
lsr: Mud slide reported on Dog Tail Rd north of Highway 133.
Some street flooding on Grandview Lane.
